answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The wharf lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ferrous is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The vault of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
